summary: REQ-5 is only partially implemented: the meme image appears removed and the exact message text is present after clicking “Yes”, but the post-Yes view is not “text-only” (it includes icons, headings, decorative elements, animations, and a footer). Additional styling/animation changes were made that were not requested and may conflict with stated non-goals.

missing_requirements.requirement: After the user clicks “Yes”, the app shows a simple text-only message using the exact wording and does not display additional non-text UI in the result view.
missing_requirements.reason: The result view includes multiple non-text elements (Heart icons), an additional heading (“Yay! 💕”), decorative heart row, animated classes, and a footer link—so the view is not text-only.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/retained decorative icons and extra heading/content in the post-Yes result view (e.g., Heart icons, “Yay! 💕”, decorative hearts row, footer/caffeine.ai link).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest asked for a simple text-only message after clicking “Yes”; these additional UI elements are not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced/used animations in the post-Yes view (e.g., animate-in/fade-in, animate-pulse).
hallucinated_features.reason: Non-goals explicitly state not to add new animations after clicking “Yes”.

hallucinated_features.description: Expanded Tailwind theme configuration and global styling (romantic OKLCH palette, typography, custom animations).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-5, and may be beyond the scope of simplifying the post-Yes view.
